title: Training Notes: Return Processing Charge by Payment Method (Home Purchase Agreement)
content:
**Q. What decides the return processing charge on a Home Purchase Agreement returned-payment fee?**
How the most recent deposit payment posted to the agreement was made. The payment read is the latest deposit posting on the agreement ledger, whatever deposit component it funded, and its payment method.

**Q. What is added?**
- Where it was paid by **check**, **15.00** is added.
- Where it was paid by **ACH**, **5.00** is added.
- Otherwise nothing is added.

**Q. Is it the returned payment's method that counts?**
The rule reads the most recent deposit payment posted to the agreement, which may or may not be the payment that was returned.

**Check yourself (hypothetical ledgers).**

| Most recent deposit posting on the agreement ledger | Added |
|---|---|
| Paid by check | 15.00 |
| Paid by ACH | 5.00 |
| Paid by wire | Nothing |
| Paid by card | Nothing |
| Reservation funds moved by internal transfer | Nothing |

*Worked case.* An agreement ledger shows an ACH deposit posted on 2 March and a wire deposit posted on 9 March; the most recent deposit payment is the wire of 9 March, so nothing is added, even if the payment returned was the ACH payment of 2 March.
